sourceChecks.text: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon; and Mered’s wife bore Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
sourceChecks.previousContext: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
sourceChecks.nextContext: His wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.
